title: Toolbar heatmap capture: data_url field must flow through toolbar form, serializer, and generated clients
answers: Toolbar saved heatmap loses wildcard pattern
How does the toolbar send the data URL when saving a heatmap?
Adding a field to the saved heatmap capture request
body:
The capture request carries `url` (exact captured page) separately from optional `data_url` (overlay pattern; omitted/empty defaults to `url`).
- Toolbar: frontend/src/toolbar/stats/heatmapCaptureLogic.ts builds FormData via buildBaseFormData(href, dataUrl) for both the multi-width and single-width fallback paths; the value comes from currentPageLogic `wildcardHref`. Any new form builder must pass it too.
- Backend: SavedHeatmapCaptureRequestSerializer.data_url (URLField, required=False, allow_blank=True) and `capture` in products/web_analytics/backend/api/heatmaps_api.py (`validated.get("data_url") or url`).
- Serializer/help_text changes require regenerating: products/web_analytics/frontend/generated/api.schemas.ts, api.ts, api.zod.ts and services/mcp/src/api/generated.ts (do not hand-edit).
- Tests: heatmapCaptureLogic.test.ts and test_heatmap_screenshots.py cover exact, wildcard, omitted, empty.

search: Toolbar heatmap capture: the data_url field must be passed through buildBaseFormData in frontend, SavedHeatmapCaptureRequestSerializer (URLField, required=False, allow_blank=True) in backend, and regenerated API clients without hand-editing. The data_url carries the optional overlay pattern (defaults to url when omitted/empty); any new form builder or serializer change must include it in both frontend/src/toolbar/stats/heatmapCaptureLogic.ts and products/web_analytics/backend/api/heatmaps_api.py. Serializer changes automatically require regenerating products/web_analytics/frontend/generated/api.schemas.ts, api.ts, api.zod.ts, and services/mcp/src/api/generated.ts. Tests in heatmapCaptureLogic.test.ts and test_heatmap_screenshots.py cover exact, wildcard, omitted, and empty cases for the /saved/capture/ endpoint.
